sn1.22:1.1: To “impact” (_phusati_, elsewhere “contact” or “touch”) is to create harmful karma, which is the “it” that in turn harms the ones who impacts.
sn1.22:2.1: This verse occurs with a troublesome brahmin at [sn7.4:2.1](); as rejoinder to Kokālika’s attack on Sāriputta and Moggallāna at [snp3.10:14.1]() (see [sn6.10](), which has the story without this verse); and at [dhp125]().
